Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SpectraOps — ask for exec waiver: combined credits + 60d trial extension

Naomi / Marissa,

Quick context: SpectraOps is a 50–100 seat security platform provider evaluating Redwood for behaviour-driven incident summarization and embeddings at inference scale. They ran a small POC last month; feedback is positive, but procurement is pushing back on TCO and requests a longer POC window + offset credits to run a proper production-like test.

What I'm asking for: an exception to offer a consolidated incentive bundle for the onramp: 50k in free credits (usable over 90 days) plus a 60-day trial extension (total POC window = 120 days). They'll convert to a committed Dedicated plan only if performance stays within our latency SLOs and their usage profile matches our cost model.

Why this is reasonable: SpectraOps is a strategic target in security vertical — potential ARR 250–400k/year with a multi-region footprint. Their pilot includes a tight integration with our embeddings and reranking routes which, if successful, will drive predictable throughput. They have active references in their vertical and a fast procurement cycle if we greenlight the ask.

Risks / conditions I'm proposing:
- Credits capped at the first 50k and only applied to the SpectraOps account id (prevents cross-account transfer)
- SOW and AUP to be signed before credits are issued
- If they don't convert to at least a 12-month commitment within 150 days of trial start, credits are reclaimed / no further extension

Attachments: mutual action plan v2 (attached), SOW draft.

Asking for: Exec approval for the consolidated incentive bundle (credits + extension) and sign-off on the conditions above. If approved, I'll send the formal offer to Samira and Daniel and loop legal for SOW redlines.

Thanks,
Aditya
Rep, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Forwarding Aditya's note — he's requesting an exception for SpectraOps (see summary below). Quick take: pipeline looks healthy, customer has a credible technical evaluation plan but procurement is asking for incentives to accelerate the internal signoffs.

Key ask: 50k credits + 60-day extension (120-day total). Proposed guardrails in the quoted mail: SOW + AUP required; credits applied only to account; conversion to a 12-month commit required within 150 days or credits reclaimed.

I'm inclined to approve with one tweak: reduce credits to 40k and require a documented performance checkpoint at 45 days (simple eval run that we define) — if they hit the checkpoint we release the remaining 25k of credits (so split release). That mitigates blowouts and forces an early technical gate.

Could you weigh in with final approval or alternate direction? If we get signoff I'll draft an approval note and notify legal to prepare a redlined SOW.
